New CIRES-led research, which demonstrates a new method for sampling microplastics in the atmosphere using an uncrewed aerial system (UAS), aims to change that. The findings are published in the journal Scientific Reports.
items.title: New method measures microplastics in the air using an uncrewed aerial system

items.teaser: The extreme heat waves we have seen over the last few years may only serve as a preview of what is to come as a result of climate change.
